' >&2    return 1  fi  if [ -L "$HOME/Documents" ] || [ -L "$R" ]; then    printf 'STOP: the checkout path is a symlink; nothing was changed

'  else    printf 'STOP: %s holds other or incomplete work; it was not changed
' "$R" >&2    return 1  fi  if [ ! -f "$R/shared/run_omp.py" ] || [ ! -f "$M/shared/case/verify_tool_proof.py" ] || [ ! -f "$M/scripts/verify-setup.sh" ]; then    printf 'STOP: the checkout is missing course files
' >&2    return 1  fi  printf 'CHECKOUT READY %s
' "$R"}course_get_checkout
